fact: Senegal relaunched its National Digital Addressing (ANN) project with a two-day workshop opened on 5 August 2026 by the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs, aiming at a unified, georeferenced national address database, with the pilot phase to finish within one year before gradual nationwide expansion.

Senegal's ministry opened a new phase of the Adressage Numerique National (ANN), initiated in 2021 and presented in 2023 as 'Un Senegalais, une adresse', with a relaunch workshop in early August 2026 and a pilot phase due within a year before progressive national extension, per We are Tech.

Senego reports the Ministry of Telecommunications and Digital Affairs opened on 5 August 2026 a two-day workshop to relaunch the Adressage Numerique National (ANN) project, which already has technical progress, with the priority of completing the pilot phase in one year before national deployment.
